properties.rationale: User (who:ajs, standing policy from 2026-07-23): validation happens through the trials programme — docs/trials/ is where "built the right thing" is exercised against operational intent; formal validation-kind Verification nodes are not this project's tracking mechanism. Re-fired because cap:cluster-claims joined the set (36 → 37). Sharply apt here: the unit tests prove a claim never blocks and overlaps are reported, but whether an ADVISORY claim actually reduces collisions among real people who can ignore it is not a property any test can establish. It is a social question about a tool, and the only honest answer comes from two people using it on one design and reporting whether they collided less.
